t: Ahead of you is Tower Bridge, a Grade I listed bridge across the Thames, close to the Tower of London. It combines bascule and suspension spans, and until 1960 it was also a cantilever bridge. It was built between 1886 and 1894. Sir Horace Jones designed it, and he was the City of London's architect from 1864 until his death. He didn't see it finished, as it was completed after he died. John Wolfe Barry engineered it, helped by Henry Marc Brunel. It's one of five London bridges owned by the City Bridge Foundation, a charity founded in 1282.
